name: Festival bonus for an RMG worker, grade G5 at Tk 12,500, one day short of a year's service on the cut-off: not due
source: hand-worked from the BD pack rules
working: Service from 2 Mar 2026 to the cut-off 1 Mar 2027 = 11 completed months (the 12th completes on 2 Mar 2027); 11 < 12, so no bonus
Had it been due: BASIC = round((12500 − 2450) ÷ 1.5) = 6700, so the bonus would have been 6700
